)

    $count++

# Unstage the broad _Project add, then re-stage only rename + HDRP compile fix
git restore --staged -- "Assets/_Project"

# Re-add rename renames (git mv already in index partially - restore may have undone; re-do carefully)
git add -- `
  "Assets/_Project/Editor/Rendering/GenesisHdrpMigrationUtility.cs" `
  "Assets/_Project/Editor/DarkMatterGenesisEditorMenus.cs" `
  "Assets/_Project/Editor/DarkMatterGenesisEditorMenus.cs.meta" `
  "Assets/_Project/Editor/DarkMatterGenesisToolsWindow.cs" `
  "Assets/_Project/Editor/DarkMatterGenesisToolsWindow.cs.meta" `
  "Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/DarkMatterGenesisUiPalette.cs" `
  "Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/DarkMatterGenesisUiPalette.cs.meta"

# If old paths still tracked as deleted, ensure deletions staged
if (Test-Path "Assets/_Project/Editor/SurvivalPioneerToolsWindow.cs") { Write-Host "WARN old tools still on disk" } else { git add -u -- "Assets/_Project/Editor/SurvivalPioneerToolsWindow.cs" "Assets/_Project/Editor/SurvivalPioneerEditorMenus.cs" "Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/SurvivalPioneerUiPalette.cs" 2>$null }

# Add only .cs files whose diff is the identifier rename (and rules/docs for rename)
$toAdd = @()
$changed = git diff --name-only -- "Assets/_Project"
foreach ($f in $changed) {
  if ($f -notmatch '\.cs$') { continue }
  $diff = git diff -- "$f"
  # Skip if diff has unrelated changes beyond rename tokens / whitespace
  $suspicious = $diff | Select-String -Pattern '^[+-]' | Where-Object {
    $_.Line -notmatch '^[+-]{3}' -and
    $_.Line -notmatch 'SurvivalPioneer|DarkMatterGenesis' -and
    $_.Line -match '^[+-].*\S'
  }
  if (-not $suspicious) {
    $toAdd += $f
  }
}
Write-Host "Pure rename CS files: $($toAdd.Count)"
if ($toAdd.Count -gt 0) { git add -- $toAdd }
